title: Explicit negative findings and evidence revision in EAL/2
question: For eight independently authored bounded engineering roots, does a checked EAL/2 argument preserve correct status transitions when valid negative findings are added and then invalidated, and does model-authored EAL revision outperform an equally capable generic argument graph under the same budget?

scope.system_or_population: A pinned text-only model, EAL/2 host, and independent equal-capability generic graph checker on eight selected new synthetic engineering roots.
scope.conditions: Two-stage pilot: Stage A uses reviewed pre-authored multi-route arguments; Stage B drafts and revises from ordinary independent briefs. Three frozen evidence states per root.
scope.spatial_scope: Local host and one pinned model API, with synthetic finite observations and no physical device claim.
scope.temporal_scope: One frozen campaign after fixture, oracle, provider and scorer validation; Stage B is released only by pre-outcome readiness gates.
exclusions: Hidden model cognition inferred from public output
Continuous-time absence from a sampled trace
Physical truth of an asserted measurement
Unique computational expressivity against an equal generic argument engine
A conclusion about Stage B from Stage A pre-authored programmes

claims.statement: On frozen bounded tasks with a faithful pre-authored programme and trusted synthetic records, a checked EAL/2 host yields more correct qualified status transitions and fewer false supports under negative-evidence change than a tool-free model reading raw EAL.
claims.scope_limit: Finite synthetic roots, reviewed programme and trusted input only; a whole-system allocation effect rather than a syntax or model-cognition effect.
claims.success_consequence: Use checked EAL as a candidate status-and-revision interface for this workflow.
claims.failure_consequence: Repair the source, method, objection or host correspondence before claiming a benefit.

claims.statement: At equal model budget and equal interpreter/gate capability, model-authored EAL programmes survive a negative-evidence addition and invalidation more faithfully than model-authored generic argument graphs.
claims.scope_limit: Practical draft-and-revision pipeline on eight independent briefs, not intrinsic language superiority.
claims.success_consequence: Replicate a measured EAL-specific authoring and maintenance benefit.
claims.failure_consequence: Treat EAL as one equally capable representation and investigate the generic alternative.

claims.statement: An explicit typed negative predicate, used as a required premise of an objection, activates or withdraws an attack according to coverage, provenance, scope and method result in the installed bounded EAL/2 fragment.
claims.scope_limit: Only the independently referenced synthetic finite trace and checked binding; no real-world non-detection or continuous-time inference.
claims.success_consequence: Retain this bounded negative-finding pattern and inspect its trace.
claims.failure_consequence: Repair the parser, method or graph semantics before live calls.

claims.statement: Raw EAL source improves a tool-free recipient’s revision statuses relative to a meaning-equivalent concise generic graph.
claims.scope_limit: Rendering-bundle effect on one model; tokenisation, familiarity and prompt length can mediate it.
claims.success_consequence: Replicate the finite positive contrast on new roots.
claims.failure_consequence: Drop raw notation as a basis for adoption.

assumptions.statement: Expected source and report statuses are specified independently of both runtimes before model outputs.
assumptions.test_or_justification: Two reviewers independently adjudicate each ordinary brief, evidence state, finite coverage condition, objection target and transition; reconcile before freeze and cross-check with a third hand-worked route.
assumptions.failure_consequence: Suspend correctness claims for disputed roots.

assumptions.statement: A formal source represents the intended ordinary engineering claim, evidence identity, scope, method and attacks.
assumptions.test_or_justification: Blinded reviewers compare every Stage B submitted source with the immutable brief before execution; report exact failed fields.
assumptions.failure_consequence: A correct runtime status cannot count as success on that brief.

assumptions.statement: A negative predicate is licensed only by a finite explicit detection or sampled-trace contract with appropriate coverage and binding.
assumptions.test_or_justification: Include direct witnessed violation, complete sampled non-violation, incomplete coverage and scope-mismatched controls; inspect method output and typed proposition.
assumptions.failure_consequence: Reject unsupported absence claims; no inference from missing records alone.

assumptions.statement: Generic graph and EAL systems receive the same propositions, registered method, attack semantics, records, host gate and diagnostic budget.
assumptions.test_or_justification: Parse-equivalence and independent implementation parity on pre-outcome positive, attack, invalidation and restoration fixtures; log code reuse.
assumptions.failure_consequence: Attribute differences only to an implementation bundle, not representation.

assumptions.statement: Eight root briefs are genealogically distinct from the five exposed templates and from each other.
assumptions.test_or_justification: Independent authoring and duplicate/genealogy review before freeze, with method and attack-family counts.
assumptions.failure_consequence: Restrict findings to dependent template demonstrations.

assumptions.statement: Condition order, model snapshot, cache and session history do not systematically track format or evidence state.
assumptions.test_or_justification: Fresh Stage A one-shot contexts; counterbalanced order, recorded seed/model/usage, no automatic retry; parallel Stage B threads have separate root and route contexts.
assumptions.failure_consequence: Do not attribute observed differences to the assigned format.

assumptions.statement: Synthetic observation identities are bound to a separately frozen acquisition fixture; this does not establish the truth of an actual sensor.
assumptions.test_or_justification: Source/observation/time/context/method digest cross-check; forged, stale and restoration controls.
assumptions.failure_consequence: Host integrity and any real-world inference fail.

hypotheses.label: Checked revision
hypotheses.statement: Checked EAL source binding, negative-predicate computation and attack resolution produce a practically useful gain in status reversal and false-support control over raw tool-free EAL.

hypotheses.label: Raw sufficiency
hypotheses.statement: The text-only model already performs these binding and attack operations, leaving no meaningful endpoint gain for checked execution on these roots.
hypotheses.scope: Same Stage A roots and evidence.

hypotheses.label: EAL revision advantage
hypotheses.statement: Under equal host capabilities and diagnostic budgets, EAL model drafts and evidence-change revisions retain brief correspondence and correct statuses more often than generic graph drafts.
hypotheses.scope: Stage B independent briefs, pinned model and budget.

hypotheses.label: Generic graph rival
hypotheses.statement: An equally capable reusable generic graph is at least as faithful and efficient under negative-evidence revision.

hypotheses.label: Typed negative attack
hypotheses.statement: Only a covered, bound negative claim activates its dependent objection; invalidating the negative source withdraws the attack without altering the original positive records.

hypotheses.label: Absence shortcut
hypotheses.statement: A missing, partial or wrong-scope non-detection is incorrectly treated as a decisive negative finding despite the explicit contract.

hypotheses.label: Raw syntax effect
hypotheses.statement: EAL source yields more correct negative-finding revision statuses than the parse-equivalent generic view without host execution.

hypotheses.label: No raw syntax gain
hypotheses.statement: The generic graph equals or exceeds EAL raw-status accuracy on the same states.

predictions.expected_pattern: Host statuses follow the independent three-state references more often than raw EAL responses, with no increase in false support.
predictions.magnitude_or_range: Pilot target: >=0.20 root-weighted complete-sequence correctness gain; descriptive only.
predictions.time_window: Stage A one-shot state or Stage B current revision turn as specified
predictions.tolerance: Exact status/reference/trace scoring; eight-root descriptive uncertainty; no population p-value.

predictions.expected_pattern: Raw model returns the complete correct three-state sequence on as many roots as the host.
predictions.magnitude_or_range: Report exact discordance and uncertainty, not equivalence from a nonsignificant result.
predictions.time_window: Stage A one-shot state or Stage B current revision turn as specified
predictions.tolerance: Exact status/reference/trace scoring; eight-root descriptive uncertainty; no population p-value.

predictions.expected_pattern: At the same three calls per root/route, EAL drafts and revisions preserve more complete brief correspondence and correct final statuses than the generic route; any cost premium is reported.
predictions.magnitude_or_range: Pilot target: >=0.20 root-weighted complete-sequence gain with no increased false support; not a confirmed threshold.
predictions.time_window: Stage A one-shot state or Stage B current revision turn as specified
predictions.tolerance: Exact status/reference/trace scoring; eight-root descriptive uncertainty; no population p-value.

predictions.expected_pattern: A covered negative claim changes the selected objection/target status; losing coverage or scope makes that objection inactive and restores the independently expected result.
predictions.magnitude_or_range: All frozen semantic invariants exact; any contrary result is an implementation or fixture defect.
predictions.time_window: Stage A one-shot state or Stage B current revision turn as specified
predictions.tolerance: Exact status/reference/trace scoring; eight-root descriptive uncertainty; no population p-value.

predictions.expected_pattern: Within the same root/state, raw EAL yields more correct statuses than the equivalent generic view.
predictions.magnitude_or_range: Finite paired estimate and per-root discordance, no prior effect size.
predictions.time_window: Stage A one-shot state or Stage B current revision turn as specified
predictions.tolerance: Exact status/reference/trace scoring; eight-root descriptive uncertainty; no population p-value.

predictions.expected_pattern: Before model authoring, both equal-capability runtimes agree on all frozen canonical states and reject the same invalid identities.
predictions.magnitude_or_range: Exact 24 paired states plus signed-input tamper controls; shared prediction that cannot select a format.
predictions.time_window: Stage A one-shot state or Stage B current revision turn as specified
predictions.tolerance: Exact status/reference/trace scoring; eight-root descriptive uncertainty; no population p-value.

constructs.name: Correct qualified status sequence
constructs.definition: Exact requested claim statuses and justified support across three evidence states against an independent reference, including revision after negative finding changes.
constructs.scope: One root and its immutable synthetic variants.
validity_threats: A single correct label can be guessed or copied
Selected roots and semantic reference errors

constructs.name: Brief-to-formal correspondence
constructs.definition: The draft represents the brief’s target, quantity, scope, time, evidence identity, method, negative predicate, attack target and defeater without unintended change.
constructs.scope: Stage B ordinary briefs and three revision turns.
validity_evidence: Masked two-reviewer audit of every source planned
validity_threats: Reviewers may infer route from syntax

constructs.name: Bounded negative finding
constructs.definition: A method-checked proposition about a witnessed violation or a complete finite sampled record, used as a required premise of an objection; lack of a record is not itself an observation of absence.
validity_evidence: Temporal output includes coverage and explicitly disclaims continuous truth

constructs.name: Representation and revision burden
constructs.definition: Recorded model tokens, calls, elapsed time and implementation time for each route at matched task and budget.
constructs.scope: Pilot pipelines and local machine only.
validity_evidence: Provider usage and host clocks retained
validity_threats: Developer implementation time not prospectively observed

design.rationale: Within-root assigned text views and a sequential authoring comparison separate raw rendering, checked execution and draft/revision fidelity; deterministic negative-evidence perturbations test attack activation and restoration.
design.setting: Eight new synthetic briefs with independent references and two independent equal-capability runtimes.
design.temporal_structure: Stage A: independent one-shot states presented in counterbalanced order. Stage B: separate three-turn route threads per root; draft, valid negative finding, then scope/coverage invalidation or independently grounded defence.
design.assignment_method: Randomise Stage A root/state/view order and Stage B route order within root using a retained seed; every root receives every assigned arm.
design.allocation_concealment: Freeze source, briefs, references, state changes and route schedule before any generation; models never see expected statuses.
design.masking: Reference reviewers blind to responses; Stage B fidelity reviewers blind to outcome, with route masking limited by syntax; scorer frozen.
design.comparator: Raw EAL versus equivalent generic graph; checked EAL versus raw EAL; EAL model-authored pipeline versus equal generic graph pipeline.

units.target_population_or_system: Selected finite synthetic engineering arguments on a pinned text-only model and host; no probability sample of engineering work.
units.sampling_frame: Eight independently commissioned and genealogy-screened new ordinary briefs, including distinct negative-predicate and attack/rebuttal families.
units.experimental_unit: Root/state/view in Stage A; root/representation thread in Stage B.
units.observational_unit: One attempted model call, one source submission and one host/checker result.
units.assignment_unit: Root-state presentation and route order within root.
units.analysis_unit: Root, with three states and two formats treated as dependent; family summaries retain genealogy.
inclusion_criteria: New brief with two independent positive routes, a typed negative finding and an attack target whose status changes when the finding is valid
Negative finding can be made inapplicable by exactly one predeclared scope/coverage/provenance change without altering positive values
Both runtimes and two reviewers agree before generation
exclusion_criteria: Near duplicate of exposed five tasks or another root
Ambiguous independent reference unresolved before freeze
Generic graph lacks equal method/attack/gate capacity
units.recruitment_or_selection: Purposefully select eight distinct bounded problems before outcomes; keep excluded drafts and reasons in a pre-freeze log.

interventions_or_exposures.description: Three evidence states per root: base support/route structure, valid covered negative predicate activating an objection, then invalidated scope/coverage/provenance or independent defence; references may vary in label pattern across roots.
interventions_or_exposures.implementation: The negative proposition is a typed claim with bound registered method; objection requires it as a premise and targets a specified claim/route. Alter one field or add a genuinely independent defence at turn 3; preserve positive values.
interventions_or_exposures.timing: Stage and turn fixed in immutable schedule.
manipulation_checks: Check finite coverage, bound query, polarity and objection premise/target
Freeze all three independently adjudicated statuses
off_target_checks: Check token differences, unchanged positive sources and accidental final-status leakage
recovery_checks: Restore valid negative source and confirm original attack returns

interventions_or_exposures.description: Stage A: raw EAL and parse-equivalent concise generic graph in independent one-shot status requests; verified EAL and equal generic checker execute those exact states without model calls.
interventions_or_exposures.implementation: 8 roots x 3 states x 2 text views = 48 live calls; 8 x 3 x 2 deterministic canonical checker assessments = 48 executions. Host owns final status, and neither text view receives a computed verdict.
interventions_or_exposures.timing: Stage and turn fixed in immutable schedule.
manipulation_checks: Normalise both views to equal semantic IR
Verify model identity and prompt hashes
off_target_checks: Track length, EAL vocabulary bias and format failure
recovery_checks: Counterbalanced order and exact valid/invalid reversal

interventions_or_exposures.description: Stage B: author and revise source from ordinary brief in EAL or equal generic graph across three turns.
interventions_or_exposures.implementation: 8 roots x 2 routes x 3 calls = 48 live calls: draft, add a valid negative finding, then invalidate or independently defeat it. Each route receives same brief/change, model budget, prior source and bounded parser diagnostics, with no hidden answer. Run each output through assigned host and independent fidelity review.
interventions_or_exposures.dose_or_intensity: 48 further model calls; deterministic validations outside this count.
interventions_or_exposures.timing: Stage and turn fixed in immutable schedule.
manipulation_checks: At each turn audit brief correspondence, graph parity and same permitted diagnostics
off_target_checks: Record diagnostics token count and route order; reject extra repair calls
recovery_checks: Reassess earlier source after restoration and audit unintended edits

controls.description: Covered direct violation and complete bounded sampled-property cases.
controls.failure_mode_addressed: An invalid negative predicate could pass vacuously.
controls.implementation: Hand-worked method results and independent oracle before any generation.
controls.diagnostic_consequence: If valid controls fail, halt Stage A.

controls.description: Identical measured values with one missing endpoint, wrong scope, stale identity or rejected provenance.
controls.failure_mode_addressed: Non-detection or out-of-scope value falsely activates an objection.
controls.implementation: Pair each valid negative with one predeclared invalid counterpart; confirm objection state and target reference.
controls.diagnostic_consequence: Any invalid record that activates the objection fails the semantic test.

controls.description: Independently implemented reusable generic graph with equal rules, methods, gate and bounded diagnostics.
controls.failure_mode_addressed: Checked computation or host enforcement is credited uniquely to EAL.
controls.implementation: Cross-run all canonical states; equal authoring budget in Stage B.
controls.diagnostic_consequence: Parity failure blocks an EAL-specific conclusion.

controls.description: Alter source/observation digest, time or context while retaining internally coherent status prose.
controls.failure_mode_addressed: A copied label bypasses the host acquisition identity.
controls.implementation: Synthetic signed-log tamper/replay/restore check in both runtimes before Stage A.
controls.diagnostic_consequence: Any accepted invalid identity fails the gate and blocks Stage B.

controls.description: Always-supported and always-unsupported status maps and exact proposal-copy baseline, calculated separately for each arm.
controls.failure_mode_addressed: Label imbalance gives a trivial high score.
controls.implementation: Compute from frozen references before calls; no synthetic baseline model calls.
controls.diagnostic_consequence: A reported gain must be interpreted against structural baselines and root-level transitions.

confounds.description: A few related roots and uneven status mix.
confounds.causal_or_measurement_path: Shared templates or frequent unsupported labels inflate apparent repeated successes.
confounds.control_or_adjustment: Genealogy audit, root analysis and structural label baselines.
confounds.residual_risk: No population transport from eight purposive roots.

confounds.description: EAL and generic views differ in tokenisation and learned familiarity.
confounds.causal_or_measurement_path: Surface and length change salience independent of formal semantics.
confounds.control_or_adjustment: Common compact reference, semantic IR equality, matched response contract, token log.
confounds.diagnostic: Input lengths and format errors by route.
confounds.residual_risk: Identifies a rendering bundle, not an intrinsic language property.

confounds.description: Reference or checker coupled to EAL implementation.
confounds.causal_or_measurement_path: A shared error favours EAL checked status and makes negative switch apparently correct.
confounds.control_or_adjustment: Independent brief adjudication and independent generic implementation.
confounds.diagnostic: Publish every pre-outcome disagreement and resolve before model calls.

confounds.description: Unequal syntax diagnostics after invalid Stage B source.
confounds.causal_or_measurement_path: One route receives more correction information.
confounds.control_or_adjustment: Equal bounded field/category diagnostics and exact three-call cap.
confounds.residual_risk: Formal languages differ in error localisability; report as part of pipeline effect.

estimands.population_or_system: Eight pre-authored new roots under the pinned model and checked EAL host.
estimands.intervention_or_exposure: Host-derived EAL final status for identical frozen source and observations.
estimands.comparator: First tool-free raw-EAL response to those exact inputs.
estimands.time: At each frozen evidence state and root-complete sequence.
estimands.summary_measure: Root mean of complete three-state correctness difference; paired false-support counts and support→contested→restored transitions.
estimands.interpretation: Conditional whole-system allocation contrast; checker receives an executable method and host gate, so no syntax-specific attribution.

estimands.population_or_system: Eight ordinary root briefs assigned both routes.
estimands.intervention_or_exposure: Model authors and revises EAL under three equal calls.
estimands.comparator: Same model authors/revises equal generic graph under three calls.
estimands.time: At each frozen evidence state and root-complete sequence.
estimands.summary_measure: Within-root difference in all-turn brief fidelity and oracle-correct final assessment, with resource differences and exact discordant roots.
estimands.interpretation: Practical authoring-and-revision route effect; not a universal expressivity theorem.

estimands.intervention_or_exposure: Valid covered negative proposition then one-field invalidation/defence.
estimands.comparator: Baseline before negative source and restored valid state.
estimands.time: At each frozen evidence state and root-complete sequence.
estimands.summary_measure: Exact attack activation and expected status transitions on each frozen root; no sampling inference.
estimands.interpretation: Implementation of declared finite semantics conditional on authentic input.

estimands.comparator: Parse-equivalent concise generic graph view with same records and response contract.
estimands.time: At each frozen evidence state and root-complete sequence.
estimands.summary_measure: Paired root-average complete correctness difference and state-level discordance.

estimands.population_or_system: 24 canonical states and planned tamper controls.
estimands.comparator: Independent generic checker with same data, method, attack rules and host gate.
estimands.time: At each frozen evidence state and root-complete sequence.
estimands.summary_measure: Exact status, attack, refusal and trace-field discordance count.
estimands.interpretation: Necessary fairness check, not proof of equivalence beyond fixtures.

identification.causal_and_measurement_structure: Brief and independent acquired records define intended finite statuses; assigned format and stage alter visible source and host operations; checker outputs depend on interpreted propositions, methods and attacks; brief fidelity is a prior bridge. Randomised within-root formats identify finite-route differences if parity, references, sessions and diagnostic budgets hold. Host-versus-raw contrasts bundle computation, verification and response ownership.
identified_parameters: Finite-root paired Stage A presentation and execution differences
Finite-root Stage B route-specific draft/revision fidelity and end-to-end status differences
Deterministic gate and attack response to frozen perturbations
nonidentified_alternatives: Model internal reasoning versus label copying
EAL-specific runtime advantage if equal generic checker is identical
Continuous or physical truth from finite synthetic samples
Population engineering performance from purposive eight roots
rescue_actions: Suspend affected root before generation if pre-freeze parity fails
Revise generic comparator in a new frozen cohort if structural parity fails
Replicate on independent roots and authors for external validity
Build a registered finite detection method before any non-detection outside sampled semantics

sampling.method: Purposive pilot with eight independently authored roots; each has three linked states and both representation routes.
sampling.sample_size_or_information_target: Stage A: 8 x 3 x 2 = 48 one-shot model calls; 8 x 3 x 2 = 48 deterministic canonical runtime executions. Stage B: 8 x 2 x 3 = 48 further authoring/revision calls. Total maximum = 96 prospective model calls, contingent on pre-outcome readiness; previous 960-call plan had 24 roots x 10 packet arms x 2 syntaxes x 2 reference lengths. Neither count is 960 independent tasks. A 0.20 paired gain on eight roots is imprecise and is a pilot target, not a discovery threshold.
inputs: Prior 960-call protocol INV-EAL-MECHANISMS-001 is specified, not executed; it would compare graded supplied answer packets and checked system on pre-authored sources but cannot show model internal cognition, physical truth, ordinary-brief translation or EAL-specific authoring advantage
New briefs, references, parity implementation, final runner and current model price must be established before live calls
sampling.dependence_structure: Root is primary unit; three states and two formats are dependent. Stage B turns share a source/thread. Related families and one author may remain correlated.
sampling.multiplicity: Primary Stage A whole-system contrast and primary Stage B authoring contrast are separate bounded pilot claims; all diagnostics and costs reported without significance fishing.
sampling.attrition_or_loss: Malformed and provider failures stay in attempted denominators; missing/unattempted separately logged; no silent replacement.
sampling.result: Feasibility and effect-range calibration; no credible population 95% interval at eight selected roots.
sampling.sensitivity_analysis: Before execution enumerate discordant-root scenarios and worst-case malformed false support; after execution report root counts, descriptive intervals, leave-one-root/family-out and trivial status baselines.
sampling.stopping_implications: No outcome-dependent stop; Stage B gate checks fixture/oracle/parity and acquisition integrity before any Stage A outputs, then Stage B only on predeclared readiness independent of observed benefit. Freeze budget/cost using current price before live calls.

analysis.preprocessing_lock: Freeze exact briefs, source views, oracle statuses, method versions, graph IR, acquisition log, scorer, randomisation seed, model snapshot and request bytes. Archive raw outputs and host traces before scoring. Do not reinterpret missing evidence as physical absence.
analysis.exclusion_lock: Exclude only pre-freeze ambiguous or non-parity roots with logged reasons. All attempted calls, malformed responses and authored invalid sources stay in denominators; no post-outcome fixture replacement.

models.model_or_procedure: Within-root exact statuses, three-state sequence pass, reverse/restore transitions, false supports, syntax pair discordance, checker parity and tamper refusals.
assumptions: Independent reference and same frozen semantic graph

models.model_or_procedure: Score all three model-authored source submissions against masked brief fields, then execute valid submitted source through its assigned runtime; paired complete-sequence fidelity and status, with cost and time.
assumptions: Equal budgets, diagnostics and checker semantics

contrasts: Stage A primary: checked EAL host status versus tool-free raw EAL on identical reviewed source and records; raw model does not have the checked computation.
Stage A secondary: raw EAL versus equivalent generic graph, as a rendering-bundle estimate.
Stage B primary: model-authored/revised EAL versus model-authored/revised equal generic graph from ordinary briefs with three calls per route and no additional repairs.
Canonical deterministic EAL versus generic checker exact semantic and tamper parity, before interpreting Stage B.
analysis.uncertainty: Report each discordant root and exact finite counts, descriptive root-level interval/sensitivity only; do not treat 96 calls as independent or claim population significance.

analysis.missing_data: Attempted malformed/provider errors and invalid authored source count as endpoint failure; false support is assessed only for admitted responses with worst-case bound for missing content; unknown usage reported.
analysis.stopping_rule: No model calls until prospective freeze. After pre-outcome fixture/parity/safety gate, attempt fixed 48 Stage A slots. Stage B proceeds only if previously specified fixture/oracle/parity/credential/cost checks still pass; this gate does not depend on Stage A success. Stop on compromised credential, unbounded cost, unknown usage or provider incompatibility, retaining markers and all attempts. No silent retries.
